description: Ministry of Higher Education , Technology & Innovations - Appoint Competent Authority to University of Vocational Technology
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Dr. Bandula Gunawardana) and detailed responsibilities/portfolios (Minister of Higher Education, Technology and Innovation). It also names another individual (Senior Professor Wachcha Patabendege Ranjith Premalal de Silva) and assigns him specific powers and functions as Competent Authority of the University of Vocational Technology, making it a Hybrid gazette with both personnel appointments and detailed portfolio responsibilities.
